title: Design System: AEM Rockstar — The Gig Poster

display.purpose: Prepared homepage title only; at 900px use clamp(7rem, 12.3vw, 11rem). Uppercase.

edition.purpose: Blue edition beside the title, with an accessible edition label.

headline.purpose: Fluid homepage section headings; siblings use their own fixed reading/task roles.

title.purpose: Bold Roboto news headings, distinct from Anton display.

body.purpose: Shared scoped reading text; guide content and disclosure paragraphs cap at 70ch.

label.purpose: Small bold metadata such as agenda times; not winner-year tabs.

winner-year.purpose: Uppercase Anton year attached above the portrait, blue fill and yellow text.

read-title.purpose: Direct authored page title in a yellow band; 3rem becomes 4rem at 600px, preserving IDs and year.

read-section.purpose: Fixed 2rem guide section heading; 70ch reading column, not a poster headline.

masterclass-title.purpose: Masterclass hero heading, followed by copy and the original course logo on mobile.

form-title.purpose: Fixed 2rem Anton title at every breakpoint; form-header padding increases from 24px to 32px at 900px.

field-label.purpose: Roboto labels and legends, kept distinct from Anton headings.

field-input.purpose: Roboto text inputs and textareas; neutral readable placeholders, native radio/conditional behavior retained.

motion.name: ticket-arrow
motion.purpose: Border-drawn arrow translates 4px on hover/focus; transition removed with reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes shared link-ticket arrow and homepage recording-link transitions, and disables smooth scrolling throughout the scoped theme; existing form reduced-motion rules remain.

components.name: Ruled Topics
components.description: Editorial list excerpt, not chips or selectable filters.
components.css: .ds-topics{background:var(--rockstar-yellow,#fcdf38);color:var(--rockstar-ink,#202020);font-family:Roboto,roboto-fallback,sans-serif;font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.6}.ds-topics ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:32px 0 0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0}.ds-topics li{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rockstar-ink,#202020);padding:14px 0;width:100%;font-weight:700}@media(min-width:600px){.ds-topics li{width:calc(50% - 24px);margin-right:24px}}@media(min-width:900px){.ds-topics li{width:calc(33.333% - 24px)}}

components.name: Winner Tile — Text Excerpt
components.description: Attached blue/yellow Anton concert tab and name without a fabricated portrait. Production places the genuine square CMS portrait immediately below the tab; no image placeholder is a system primitive.

components.name: Compact Form Header
components.description: Confirmation header excerpt with the existing default title; actual descriptions, venue text, and old dates remain authored. No location emoji or poster-scale title.

components.name: Registration Text Field
components.description: Native registration input, showing its specific hover/focus/invalid treatment. Access-request fields instead use a stable shadow-drawn stroke; semantic feedback is not a brand palette extension.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--rockstar-ink,#202020);font-family:Roboto,roboto-fallback,sans-serif}.ds-field label{display:block;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6}.ds-field label span{color:#d73502;font-weight:700}.ds-field input{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:12px 16px;border:2px solid #ddd;border-radius:0;font:1rem Roboto,roboto-fallback,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:var(--rockstar-ink,#202020);caret-color:var(--rockstar-blue,#193acc);transition:border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#666}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--rockstar-blue,#193acc)}.ds-field input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--rockstar-blue,#193acc);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(0 123 255 / 10%)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rockstar-blue,#193acc);outline-offset:2px}.ds-field input:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown){border-color:#d73502}.ds-field input:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown):focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(215 53 2 / 10%)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-field input{transition:none}}

components.name: Confirmation Actions
components.description: Existing Accept/Decline controls: blue primary, blue outlined secondary, ink enabled hover, neutral disabled state. Preview has no submission behavior; actual conditional fields, loading, errors, success, and endpoints remain in the unchanged form runtime.

components.name: Agenda Session Label
components.description: Noninteractive session-type annotation, not a selectable filter; agenda names and tabular times stay Roboto. Breaks use yellow bands rather than timeline dots.

narrative.overview:
Electric fields, condensed lettering, rectangular tickets, and unboxed editorial content make the Rockstar surfaces feel like a concert bill. Practitioners and their real portraits supply the personality; the AEM Rockstar name and Adobe connection remain intact. Guides trade poster scale for readable hierarchy, while forms keep brand expression in compact headers and square controls.

This is a finished-build record, not an unconditional sitewide replacement. Shared branding, header, and footer use `body.rockstar-site`; the authored `home` theme retains homepage-only recomposition under `body.rockstar-home`. The submission guide, closed 2026 submission page, masterclass, and its descendants receive `body.rockstar-inner` and the sibling stylesheet without recomposing their blocks. Live voting/results and commerce, product, cart, and test pages are excluded. CMS-authored copy, IDs, imagery, form configuration, and endpoints remain authoritative; no new raster asset or animation was added.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow and blue fields with high-contrast ink and paper text.
Anton headlines paired with existing Roboto reading text.
Square actions, hairline divisions, and unboxed people.
Native disclosures and brief, reduced-motion-aware feedback.
Shared identity with distinct homepage, reading, masterclass, and task-form hierarchies.

rules.name: The Field Contrast Rule
rules.body: Pair ink with yellow or off-white, and off-white with blue; the replay ticket reverses to yellow with ink on its blue field.

rules.name: The Scoped Voice Rule
rules.body: Share Anton and the palette across the prepared routes, not the giant homepage scale: fixed reading roles and compact form titles preserve comprehension and task clarity.

rules.name: The Flat Bill Rule
rules.body: Keep editorial containers and people unboxed; retain hierarchy through fields, spacing, and thin rules rather than adding card elevation.

dos: **Do** keep shared tokens and shell inside the prepared route boundary, and homepage recomposition inside the homepage boundary.
**Do** preserve genuine CMS imagery, portrait identity, recording destinations, and authorable structures.
**Do** use the existing focus treatment, semantic controls, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** label historical recordings and guidance as historical; upcoming dates and registration remain unconfirmed.
**Do** retain the guide's 70ch measure, fixed reading hierarchy, compact form titles, native fields, and semantic feedback.
**Do** preserve inline symbols and block configuration; preparation strips only leading decorative emoji prefixes from direct prose headings, paragraphs, lists, and their list-item/emphasis text.
donts: **Don't** apply giant homepage display/edition sizes to guide or task-form headings, or retheme excluded routes.
**Don't** turn the flat replay, news, or community content into rounded, shadowed card grids.
**Don't** treat the working replay action as proof of upcoming registration or a confirmed lineup.
**Don't** treat preview tonal ramps in the sidecar as additional shipped palette tokens.
**Don't** reinterpret old masterclass dates, the 2026 guide, closed submissions, or mocked form responses as current availability or verified backend delivery.
